readme.text:
Mixed test
Cost-effectiveness and incremental cost analysis: figures and tables

Study: Mixed test
Prepared by: n/a
Date: October 18, 2026
Status: Draft
Made by CEICA 1.0.0 (engine 1); project digest 89aea71be748

In this folder
  Figures and tables.docx, .pdf and .html: every figure and table with its number and caption, and the methods.
  Figures: each figure as PNG (300 dpi, for documents and slides) and SVG (to edit).
  Tables: each table as CSV, and All tables.xlsx with a sheet per table.
  Mixed test calculator.xlsx: every input and result as live formulas.
  Mixed test.ceica: the project file. Open it in CEICA to continue the study.

Figures
  Figure 1. Cost-effectiveness (A) and incremental cost (B) of the watershed plans.
    Figures/Figure 01 Watershed plans.png and .svg
  Figure 2. Cost-effectiveness (A) and incremental cost (B) of the alternatives at site A.
    Figures/Figure 02 Site A.png and .svg
  Figure 3. Cost-effectiveness (A) and incremental cost (B) of the alternatives at site B.
    Figures/Figure 03 Site B.png and .svg
  Figure 4. Habitat units over time (A) and average annual cost by part (B) of the alternatives at site A. Wetland, entered as an average, is not in panel A.
    Figures/Figure 04 Benefits and costs, site A.png and .svg
  Figure 5. Habitat units over time (A) and average annual cost by part (B) of the alternatives at site B. Wetland, entered as an average, is not in panel A.
    Figures/Figure 05 Benefits and costs, site B.png and .svg

Tables
  Table 1. Study settings and the record of this analysis.
    Tables/Table 01 Study settings.csv
  Table 2. Best-buy watershed plans and their incremental costs. Each site column names the alternative in the plan, blank when the site is not in it.
    Tables/Table 02 Best-buy plans.csv
  Table 3. Final array of watershed plans. Each site column names the alternative in the plan, blank when the site is not in it.
    Tables/Table 03 Final array.csv
  Table 4. The watershed plans: lift, cost and status (4 plans). Each site column names the alternative in the plan, blank when the site is not in it.
    Tables/Table 04 All plans.csv
  Table 5. Cost-effectiveness and incremental cost of every alternative at every site. Incremental cost applies to best buys.
    Tables/Table 05 Alternatives at every site.csv
  Table 6. The alternative each site carries forward, and the status of that decision.
    Tables/Table 06 Site recommendations.csv
  Table 7. Decisions and the reasons recorded for them.
    Tables/Table 07 Decision record.csv
  Table 8. Average annual output, lift, construction cost and annualized cost of every alternative. The CE/ICA tables measure cost above No Action.
    Tables/Table 08 Benefit and cost inputs.csv
  Table 9. Average annual output by module, the total and the lift over No Action (all in AAHU).
    Tables/Table 09 Output by module.csv
  Table 10. First costs by category, interest during construction, OMRRR and annualized cost of every alternative.
    Tables/Table 10 Cost by category.csv

Reading the data files
  CSV files hold plain numbers: lift and cost are the rounded values the analysis compared, so sorting reproduces its ties. TRUE and FALSE mark cost-effective plans and best buys. A blank cell has no value; in a plan table, a blank site column means the site is not in the plan.
  In All tables.xlsx, numbers keep their full precision under the display format, and a missing value reads n/a.
